newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR market inactive as rates slip.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR market inactive as rates slip.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) slipped on Monday but there was no activity, traders said.
"The actual level of PHIBOR cannot be ascertained at the moment because few banks were quoting," one said. "Everybody is just watching the foreign exchange market."
Traders said the swap market may see more activity once the peso stabilises.
It fell to a low of 29.75 per dollar on Monday after the Central Bank loosened its grip on the market, hoping to end months of speculation after Thailand's financial problems.
